operator_question: What exact decision or queue can this score change?
minimum_evidence: Named decision audience consequence and prohibited uses
release_condition: Permitted use and excluded uses are recorded
next_review: Before first use or scope change

operator_question: What exact event is the model trying to predict?
minimum_evidence: Positive event unit of analysis window exclusions and label authority
stop_condition: Positive outcome differs by site or is ambiguous
release_condition: Outcome definition is shared or differences are explicitly bounded

operator_question: Is the number a probability rank rules score or another output?
stop_condition: Score meaning is unknown or a rank is displayed as a probability
release_condition: Meaning is defined and the interface uses matching language

operator_question: Which model feature set and version produced the score?
minimum_evidence: Model ID version feature contract and deployment time
stop_condition: Model or feature version cannot be reproduced
release_condition: Exact version and feature contract are recorded
next_review: After every model or feature release

operator_question: Which records sites and operating conditions were evaluated?
minimum_evidence: Period eligible records settled outcomes exclusions and site conditions
stop_condition: Evaluation data do not resemble the permitted deployment setting
release_condition: Population and deployment boundary are aligned or use is narrowed

operator_question: Is there enough settled evidence for this site or supported site group?
minimum_evidence: Counts of eligible positive negative unresolved corrected and excluded records
stop_condition: Sample is too small unstable or unresolved for the claimed use
release_condition: Local or group evidence supports the bounded conclusion

operator_question: What performance is observed at the selected threshold?
minimum_evidence: Threshold-specific precision recall error counts and evaluation window
stop_condition: Only an overall score or different threshold is reported
release_condition: Measures match the exact threshold population and use

operator_question: What happens after a false positive or false negative?
minimum_evidence: Consequence map review burden customer impact safety and correction route
stop_condition: Material consequence has no owner or release control
release_condition: Error costs and proportional review are recorded

operator_question: Who or what is systematically over-selected delayed or missed?
minimum_evidence: Site-level and relevant group results with limitations
stop_condition: Average performance hides a material unsupported subgroup or site condition
release_condition: Known differences are measured bounded and assigned

operator_question: Who reviews and who may release the resulting action?
minimum_evidence: Named reviewer approver and handback rule
stop_condition: Model output can trigger consequential work without required authority
release_condition: Review and release authority match the decision class

operator_question: What change invalidates the current calibration?
minimum_evidence: Triggers for model feature label population threshold and operating-condition change
release_condition: Current evidence covers the changed condition or use is held

operator_question: How are wrong labels thresholds displays and downstream decisions corrected?
minimum_evidence: Versioned correction path affected-decision trace rollback owner and readback
stop_condition: Material error cannot be traced or corrected
release_condition: Correction method rollback boundary and completion evidence are recorded
